_DATA_STATUS: EMISSION FACTOR TABLE - values marked status=CITED carry a published source verified against the original; the stage-2 value marked status=DERIVED_FROM_CITED is composed arithmetically from two cited component factors with documented synthetic composition assumptions. Activity data is generated separately and is entirely SYNTHETIC.
retrievedDate: 2026-08-06 (citations verified 2026-08-06; remaining factors sourced and verified 2026-08-07)

factors.citation: International Aluminium Institute (n.d.). Primary Aluminium Greenhouse Gas Emissions Intensity: 2023 global average 14.8 tCO2e/t, full life cycle (cradle-to-gate), covering mining, refining, anode production, electrolysis and casting. Retrieved August 6, 2026.
factors.verifyNote: VERIFIED 2026-08-06 against the IAI statistics page and the December 2024 IAI release (15.1 in 2022 to 14.8 in 2023).

factors.citation: Composed from two cited component factors in Lovehagen, N., Malmodin, J., Bergmark, P., & Matinfar, S. (2023). Assessing embodied carbon emissions of communication user devices by combining approaches. Renewable and Sustainable Energy Reviews, 183, 113422: bare multilayer PCB ~44 kg CO2e/m2 per layer, i.e. ~352 kg CO2e/m2 at 8 layers and ~60 kg CO2e/kg at ~6 kg/m2 (supply-chain data incl. scope 3); IC manufacturing ~2.5 kg CO2e/cm2 of known-good die (range 2-3, up to 3.5 for high-end).
factors.verifyNote: VERIFIED 2026-08-07 against the OA full text. Composition (SYNTHETIC assumptions, documented in data-dictionary.md): a 0.35 kg populated board = 0.25 kg bare board (0.25 x 60 = 15 kg CO2e) + ~20 cm2 known-good die area (20 x 2.5 = 50 kg CO2e) = 65 kg CO2e per board = 185,714 g CO2e per kg populated board. Cross-check: Negi, Rani & Pan (2026, iScience 29(5), 115559) consolidate bare-board figures (18.6-179 kg CO2e/m2 by layer count) and show ICs dominate populated-board footprints.

factors.citation: Peiseler, L., Schenker, V., Schatzmann, K., Pfister, S., Wood, V., & Schmidt, T. (2024). Carbon footprint distributions of lithium-ion batteries and their materials. Nature Communications, 15, Article 10301 - NMC811 median 74 kgCO2e/kWh (5th-95th pct 59-115); LFP median 62. Methodological lineage: Argonne GREET battery LCA.
factors.verifyNote: VERIFIED 2026-08-06: author list corrected from the earlier Degen misattribution; medians confirmed (74 NMC811 / 62 LFP).

factors.citation: Lovehagen, N., Malmodin, J., Bergmark, P., & Matinfar, S. (2023). Assessing embodied carbon emissions of communication user devices by combining approaches. Renewable and Sustainable Energy Reviews, 183, 113422: display industry average emission factor 222 kg CO2e/m2 shipped display area (supply-chain data).
factors.verifyNote: VERIFIED 2026-08-07 against the OA full text. The paper notes the PAIA PCF tool implies ~1,400 kg CO2e/m2 (about 6x higher) and attributes the divergence mainly to PAIA's high display factors; the industry-average 222 is adopted here.

factors.verifyNote: VERIFIED 2026-08-06 against IEA Electricity 2025 (445 gCO2/kWh in 2024, declining to 400 by 2027). CO2, not full CO2e; global average.

factors.citation: Peiseler, L., Schenker, V., Schatzmann, K., Pfister, S., Wood, V., & Schmidt, T. (2024). Carbon footprint distributions of lithium-ion batteries and their materials. factors.citation: US EPA (2023). Waste Reduction Model (WARM) version 16, December 2023: recycling emission factor for Portable Electronic Devices -1.0618 MTCO2E per short ton (= -1.1704 kg CO2e per kg), net of transport, processing and avoided virgin-material production. Category covers laptops, tablets and similar portable devices.
factors.verifyNote: VERIFIED 2026-08-07 by reading the factor from the WARM v16 Excel tool's internal factor sheet (Summary Data, 'Portable Electronic Devices', recycling column: -1.06176863077509 MTCO2E/short ton; Mixed Electronics alternative: -0.9039). Documentation: EPA WARM electronics chapter (December 2023).

realismAnchor.description: Published cradle-to-grave laptop footprints used ONLY to sanity-check generated totals, not as inputs.
realismAnchor.manufacturingShareCheck: manufacturing (stages 1-6) expected to exceed use phase for many models

sources.citation: Dell. Carbon Footprint of a Typical Business Laptop From Dell (whitepaper): 300-400 kgCO2e cradle-to-grave.
Devera LCA benchmark (10,000 simulations): median 215.1 kgCO2e, typical range 157.9-286.7.
Circular Computing: manufacture is ~75-85% of a laptop's overall footprint, dominated by motherboard, SSD, display.
Lovehagen et al. (2023, RSER 183, 113422): representative 2020 laptop embodied emissions 200 kg CO2e (independent corroboration of the generated reference instance).
